description_en: Invokes this operation to query the details of a specified over-the-air update upgrade package, including the name, type, and status of the package
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定OTA升级包的详细信息，包括升级包的名称、类型、状态等
name: QueryOTAFirmware

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The over-the-air update upgrade package ID, which is the unique identity of the upgrade package.

The over-the-air update upgrade package ID is one of the parameters returned when you invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html to create an upgrade package.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html to view the ID from the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包ID，升级包的唯一标识符。

OTA升级包ID是调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html创建升级包时，返回的参数之一。

可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html，从返回参数中查看
parameters.name: firmware_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

FirmwareInfo.description_en: The update package information returned if the call was successful. For more information, see the following parameters included in FirmwareInfo
FirmwareInfo.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的升级包信息。详情参见以下FirmwareInfo包含的参数

DestVersion.description_en: The version number of the current over-the-air update upgrade package

FirmwareDesc.description_en: The description of the over-the-air update upgrade package

FirmwareId.description_en: The over-the-air update upgrade package ID, which is the unique identity of the upgrade package
FirmwareId.description_zh: OTA升级包ID，升级包的唯一标识符

FirmwareName.description_en: The name of the over-the-air update upgrade package

FirmwareSign.description_en:
The signature value of the over-the-air update upgrade package file content.

This parameter is returned only when the over-the-air update upgrade package contains a single upgrade package file
FirmwareSign.description_zh:
OTA升级包文件内容的签名值。

OTA升级包中仅有一个升级包文件时，返回该参数

FirmwareSize.description_en:
The size of the over-the-air update upgrade package file, in bytes.

This parameter is returned only when the over-the-air update upgrade package contains a single upgrade package file
FirmwareSize.description_zh:
OTA升级包文件大小，单位为字节。

OTA升级包中仅有一个升级包文件时，返回该参数

FirmwareUrl.description_en:
The URL of the upgrade package file stored in OSS.

This parameter is returned only when the over-the-air update upgrade package contains a single upgrade package file
FirmwareUrl.description_zh:
OSS存储升级包文件的URL。

OTA升级包中仅有一个升级包文件时，返回该参数

ModuleName.description_en:
The module name of the over-the-air update upgrade package.

The upgrade package module distinguishes between upgrades for different modules of devices under the same product. For more information, see [Add a custom OTA module in an upgrade package]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202664.html）
ModuleName.description_zh:
OTA升级包的模块名称。

升级包模块用于区分同产品下设备的不同模块的升级。更多信息，请参见[添加升级包中的自定义OTA模块]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202664.html）

MultiFiles.description_en: The list of over-the-air update upgrade package files. This parameter is returned when the over-the-air update upgrade package contains multiple upgrade package files
MultiFiles.description_zh: OTA升级包文件列表信息。OTA升级包中有多个升级包文件时，返回此参数

FileMd5.description_en: The MD5 value of the over-the-air update upgrade package file

Name.description_en: The name of the over-the-air update upgrade package file

SignValue.description_en: The signature value of the over-the-air update upgrade package file content
SignValue.description_zh: OTA升级包文件内容的签名值

Size.description_en: The size of the over-the-air update upgrade package file, in bytes
Size.description_zh: OTA升级包文件大小，单位为字节

Url.description_en: The URL of the update package file stored in OSS

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the over-the-air update upgrade package belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the over-the-air update upgrade package belongs
ProductName.description_zh: OTA升级包所属产品的名称

SignMethod.description_en: The signature method of the over-the-air update upgrade package

SrcVersion.description_en:
The version number of the over-the-air update upgrade package to be upgraded from.

This parameter is returned only for delta update upgrade packages. For more information about upgrade package types, see the description of the Type parameter
SrcVersion.description_zh:
待升级的OTA升级包版本号。

仅差分升级的升级包返回该参数。升级包类型的说明，请参见参数Type的描述

Status.description_en:
The status of the over-the-air update upgrade package.

-1: Authentication not required.
0: Not authenticated.
1: Authenticated.
2: Authenticating.
3: Authentication failed
Status.description_zh:
OTA升级包状态。

-1：不需要验证。
0：未验证。
1：已验证。
2：验证中。
3：验证失败

Type.description_en:
The type of the OTA update package.

0: full update package. The over-the-air update package file contains the complete update package. The full update package is pushed to devices for the update.
1: delta update package. The over-the-air update package file contains only the differences between the new version and the previous version. Only the differences are pushed to devices for the update
Type.description_zh:
OTA升级包类型。

0：整包升级包，您上传的升级包文件包含完整的升级包，将推送整包升级包给设备进行升级。
1：差分升级包，您上传的升级包文件仅包含新版本升级包与之前版本的差异部分，仅推送差异部分给设备进行升级

Udi.description_en:
The custom information pushed to devices. The text content is not restricted in format and cannot exceed 4,096 characters in length.

After an update task is created, IoT Platform pushes this custom information to devices along with the update notification
Udi.description_zh:
推送给设备的自定义信息。不限制文本内容的格式，长度不超过4096个字符。

创建升级任务后，物联网平台向设备推送升级通知时，会将该自定义信息下发给设备
Udi.example: {"ota_notice":"升级底层摄像头驱动，解决视频图像模糊的问题。"}

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the over-the-air update upgrade package was created, in UTC format
UtcCreate.description_zh: 创建OTA升级包的时间，UTC格式

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the over-the-air update upgrade package was last modified, in UTC format
UtcModified.description_zh: OTA升级包最后一次修改时的时间，UTC格式

VerifyProgress.description_en:
The verification progress of the OTA update package.

0: Not verified.
100: Verification completed.
A value N between 0 and 100: indicates that N% of devices have completed over-the-air update. Check the returned Status parameter to determine the verification status of over-the-air update package
VerifyProgress.description_zh:
OTA升级包的验证进度。

0：未验证。
100：已完成验证。
0至100之间的数值N：表示N%的设备已完成升级。升级包验证状态请根据返回参数Status判断

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
